mapper.select: SELECT dp.*, dc.category_name, u.real_name AS applicant_name FROM device_purchase dp LEFT JOIN device_category dc ON dp.category_id = dc.id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON dp.applicant_id = u.id WHERE dp.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_purchase(device_name, model, category_id, quantity, unit_price, supplier, applicant_id, purpose, status) VALUES(#{deviceName}, #{model}, #{categoryId}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{supplier}, #{applicantId}, #{purpose}, #{status})
